text: Sync a single nurse note instantly to both Epic and CareFlow systems
Display a real-time patient list filtered by ward, showing name, ID, and bed number
Automatically update patient list within 5 seconds when a patient is moved or discharged
Provide a simple note entry form with templates that dynamically change fields based on template selection
Suggest a default template based on time of day and shift pattern, allowing nurse override
Show a count badge on each patient in the list indicating number of successful notes sent during the shift
Autosave note drafts locally during entry and interruptions
Lock sent notes from editing; corrections must be sent as new follow-up notes
Handle failed note sends by showing a red Failed badge with a Retry button for immediate resend
Persist failed notes locally with a persistent failure state until successfully sent or nurse contacts IT
Prevent nurse from moving on or closing a failed note until it is resolved or escalated
Prompt nurse to confirm sending a note if the patient has been moved or discharged before sending
Block sending notes to discharged patients’ records; allow sending to moved patients with a 'Moved' flag
Provide a read-only summary dashboard in the app for ward managers showing note counts and sync failure alerts
Show nurses immediate sync failure notifications on their sent notes to enable quick retry
Ensure app loads in under 3 seconds even during peak concurrent user load (up to 125 users)
Enforce security compliance: encrypt data in transit and at rest, log all access, restrict access to own ward patients only
Do not store any patient data locally on tablets except for drafts of failed sends
Automatically log out users after 15 minutes of inactivity
Support zero downtime with automatic failover within 30 seconds and alert IT and ward manager if downtime exceeds 60 seconds
